repos.name: feder-cr/git-ai
repos.description: Open-source version of Scion: version control built for coding agents.
repos.one_liner: A version control system specifically engineered to support the unique requirements of autonomous coding agents.
bullets: Built in Go, designed as a specialized layer over standard Git workflows.
Optimizes repository state management for non-human, high-frequency agentic interactions.
Enables agents to perform complex branching, merging, and context retrieval without human intervention.
Addresses the latency and context-window limitations of traditional VCS when used by LLMs.

repos.name: Fractal-Compute-Orchestrations/FractalWorkspace
repos.description: A unified ecosystem and workspace for large-scale federated learning, bridging the gap between centralized model evolution and decentralized edge intelligence.
repos.one_liner: A unified ecosystem for large-scale federated learning bridging centralized model evolution with decentralized edge intelligence.
bullets: Python-based orchestration framework for distributed machine learning workloads.
Facilitates secure model training across disparate edge devices without centralizing raw data.
Supports complex federated learning topologies and synchronization protocols.
Ideal for privacy-preserving AI applications in finance and healthcare sectors.

repos.name: AhmadHassan-BTed/Ledgerify
repos.description: Shopify Excel Ledger intelligence platform with dark aesthetic, multi-sheet workbook analysis, 7 departmental dashboards, and live comparative benchmarking.
repos.one_liner: A specialized intelligence platform for Shopify Excel ledger analysis featuring multi-sheet benchmarking and departmental dashboards.
bullets: TypeScript-based analytical engine for processing complex financial spreadsheet data.
Provides automated comparative benchmarking and multi-departmental financial visualization.
Designed for e-commerce accounting workflows requiring high-fidelity data reconciliation.
Features a dark-mode aesthetic optimized for long-duration financial monitoring.

repos.name: AhmadHassan-BTed/Jantt
repos.description: The AI-native JSON Gantt chart engine. Dependency-free interactive timelines with React, script-tag, CLI, topological DAG solver, and formal JSON schema.
repos.one_liner: An AI-native JSON-based Gantt chart engine featuring a topological DAG solver for project management.
bullets: TypeScript-based library with zero dependencies, supporting React and CLI integration.
Uses a formal JSON schema to define complex project dependencies and timelines.
Includes a built-in topological Directed Acyclic Graph (DAG) solver for real-time scheduling.
Useful for visualizing complex project workflows in engineering and fintech development.

repos.name: AhmadHassan-BTed/OpenHeart
repos.description: Succinct Compositional Program Graph (SCPG) static analysis engine & 14-diagram UML generator in Rust.
repos.one_liner: A high-performance static analysis engine written in Rust that generates compositional program graphs and UML diagrams.
bullets: Core engine implemented in Rust for memory-safe, high-speed code analysis.
Implements Succinct Compositional Program Graph (SCPG) for deep structural code inspection.
Automates the generation of 14 distinct UML diagram types from source code.
Provides infrastructure for automated auditing, documentation, and architectural compliance.
